translation: shuroo Allah kay naam say jo sabb per meharban hai , boht meharban hai
kiya tumhen uss waqaey ( yani qayamat ) ki khabar phonchi hai jo sabb per chah jaye ga-?
boht say chehray uss din utray huye hon gay ,
museebat jheltay huye , thakan say choor !
woh dehakti hoi aag mein dakhil hon gay ,
unhen kholtay huye chashmay say paani pilaya jaye ga ,
unn kay liye aik kaantay daar jhaarr kay siwa koi khana nahi hoga ,
jo naa jism ka wazan barhaye ga , aur naa bhook mitaye ga .
boht say chehray uss din tar-o-taza hon gay ,
. ( duniya mein ) apni ki hoi mehnat ki wajeh say poori tarah mutmaeen
aalishaan jannat mein hon gay ,
jiss mein woh koi laghw baat nahi sunen gay .
uss jannat mein behtay huye chashmay hon gay ,
uss mein oonchi oonchi nishisten hon gi
aur samney rakhay huye piyalay ,
aur qitaar mein lagaye huye gadaz takiye ,
aur bichay huye qaleen !
to kiya yeh log oonton ko nahi dekhtay kay unhen kaisay peda kiya gaya-?
aur aasman ko kay ussay kiss tarah buland kiya gaya-?
aur paharon ko kay unhen kiss tarah gaarra gaya-?
aur zameen ko kay ussay kaisay bichaya gaya-?
abb ( aey payghumber ! ) tum naseehat kiye jao . tum to bus naseehat kernay walay ho .
aap ko unn per zabardasti kernay kay liye musallat nahi kiya gaya .
haan magar jo koi mun morray ga , aur kufr ikhtiyar keray ga ,
to Allah uss ko bara zabardast azab dey ga .
yaqeen jano inn sabb ko humaray paas hi loat ker aana hai ,
phir yaqeenan inn ka hisab lena humaray zimmay hai .
